title: PDI Leading Hand
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
experience: Previous experience in a similar role will be considered an asset
description_text:
Our client, operating in the automotive industry, is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented PDI Leading Hand to join their team. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to develop their careers in the automotive sector.
 Role Overview
 The PDI Leading Hand will be responsible for ensuring that new vehicles are properly inspected, prepared, and presented to customers before delivery. The role also involves maintaining high standards of cleanliness and presentation for used vehicles, while ensuring compliance with manufacturer specifications, company procedures, and Health and Safety regulations.
 Key Responsibilities
 Coordinate vehicle parking and movements with the Service and Sales Managers.
 Prepare new vehicles for delivery in accordance with manufacturer requirements and company procedures.
 Carry out necessary maintenance on stock vehicles and remove transportation mode settings where applicable.
 Ensure vehicles are adequately protected during preparation, using seat covers, floor mats, and steering wheel covers.
 Inspect vehicles for damage and promptly report any issues to the relevant managers.
 Clean and valet vehicles inside and out, including vacuuming and polishing when required.
 Operate tools and equipment safely and responsibly.
 Maintain the cleanliness and organisation of the wash bay and all PDI equipment.
 Follow pre-delivery inspection and valeting procedures in line with manufacturer and franchise standards.
 Ensure all work complies with Health and Safety regulations and company policies.
 Use the protective clothing and safety equipment provided at all times.
 Attend company-organised training sessions as required.
 Perform light maintenance duties when necessary.
 Carry out any additional duties assigned by the Service Manager.
 Requirements and Skills
 Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
 Ability to work independently and take initiative.
 Good time management and organisational skills.
 A valid Category B driving licence.
 Previous experience in a similar role will be considered an asset.
 A certificate or qualification in Automotive will be considered an asset.
 Benefits
 Health Insurance
 Loyalty Card
 Apply Now!
 Are you passionate about the automotive industry and have an eye for detail? Apply now and take the next step in your career!
